land_pattern.package: DGQ / S-PDSO-G10, PowerPAD plastic small outline (TI mechanical drawing 4073273/F 11/11; thermal-pad drawing 4206324-6/H 12/14)
land_pattern.notes: NO RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN IS PUBLISHED IN THIS PDF. Pages 37-38 carry only the PACKAGE OUTLINE and the exposed-thermal-pad dimensions; outline note D states: 'This package is designed to be soldered to a thermal pad on the board. Refer to Technical Brief, PowerPad Thermally Enhanced Package, Texas Instruments Literature No. SLMA002 for information regarding recommended board layout.' Therefore pad_size_mm, row_spacing_mm and courtyard_excess_mm are DELIBERATELY OMITTED - they are not stated. pitch_mm = 0.50 is the LEAD pitch from the outline drawing. PACKAGE OUTLINE (mm, all pairs are max/min as printed): lead pitch 0,50; lead width 0,27/0,17 with positional tolerance 0,08 M; body 3,10/2,90 (along the lead rows) x 3,10/2,90 (across, body only); overall span across formed leads 5,05/4,75; overall height 1,10 MAX; standoff 0,15/0,05; foot length 0,70/0,40; lead thickness 0,23/0,13; gauge plane 0,25; lead angle 0 to 8 deg; seating-plane flatness 0,10; mold flash/protrusion not to exceed 0,15. 'Falls within JEDEC MO-187 variation BA-T.' EXPOSED THERMAL PAD (p.38 top view, mm max/min): 2,10/1,90 measured ALONG the lead rows (nominal 2.00), 1,83/1,63 measured ACROSS between the two lead rows (nominal 1.73). pad_count 11 = 10 leads + 1 exposed thermal pad; the datasheet numbers only the 10 leads. Pin 1 is the lower-left lead in the p.3 Top View (left column top-to-bottom 1..5 = COFF, VCC, GND, BOOT, SW; right column top-to-bottom 10..6 = IADJ, PWM, VIN, CSN, DRN); the outline drawing marks pin 1 with a circular index dot at that corner.
